description: The clip view of an arrangement's audio clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2) and Sample (Warp, Reverse, Crop, Gain, Transpose, speed) boxes in bars.beats.16ths, the last two foldable, beside its source on a timeline of its own (overview, bar ruler, the stretch it plays or loops to drag, warp markers on the waveform).
name: clip-panel
